implementation_notes: BackupRunRequest 38400, BackupRestoreRequest 38402, BackupRestoreApproval 38403, and BackupRetentionEnforceRequest 38404 are handled through the existing reactor subscription/validation/dedup/authorization/EOSE/CLOSED/AUTH path.
Restore responders publish BackupRestoreStatus 6982, BackupRestoreApprovalResult 38413, and BackupRestoreResult 38412 with per-relay publish summaries persisted to restore records.

Retention responders publish BackupObservation 6984 for progress and BackupRetentionResult 38414 for terminal outcome with per-relay publish summaries persisted to retention records; projector also emits retention outcomes via existing BackupRetentionRegistry 31994.
Projector publishes BackupRunState 31996, BackupVerificationState 31997, BackupRestoreState 31998, retention outcome state 31994, and fleet BackupRuntimeObservationState 31999.
No filesystem_mock or fake backup backend is used in production backup paths; deterministic test doubles remain in _test.go files.
BackupDefinition CRUD is covered at the domain and repository layer; Nostr handlers, MCP, UI, scheduler dispatch, and executor placement are intentionally out of scope for bahia-gbo2.

Operational posture projection is recomputed from durable repository pages on backup run, restore, verification, and retention mutations; it does not poll relays or use timeout-based workflow completion.
Wave-2 web backup mutations use encrypted ContextVM methods that bridge to the existing 38400-38409 canonical command kinds; UI ACKs are command-submission receipts, not terminal workflow completion.
